hero_h1: Concierge cosmetic dentistry in Las Vegas
hero_sub: Smile design, veneers and implants, planned around the days you are in the city.
about_heading: Cosmetic dentistry on a concierge schedule
about_body:
Dr. Adam Persky and Dr. Silva Battaglin run SmileSketch Vegas as a concierge practice: longer appointments, one case at a time, and a plan that fits the time you have in Las Vegas.

They are also the original makers of the UFC mouthguard, which is where the practice's habit of building to an exact fit comes from.

services.name: Smile design
services.blurb: The case drawn, discussed and agreed with you before treatment starts.

services.name: Veneers
services.blurb: Veneer work planned as a complete case rather than one tooth at a time.

services.name: Dental implants
services.blurb: Missing teeth replaced with a plan for the whole bite, not just the gap.

services.name: Custom mouthguards
services.blurb: From the original makers of the UFC mouthguard, built to your own impressions.

footer_tagline: Concierge cosmetic dentistry, Las Vegas, Nevada.
why_this_angle: Used the concierge and dental tourism positioning from growth_trigger for the scheduling angle, and took smile design, veneers, implants and the UFC mouthguard line directly from the specialty field.
